claims.claim: Uk used ps4 with 1 pad and 10 pre-installed games which includes fifa 27, pes 27, gta...
claims.evidence: Witness only reports two black PlayStation consoles stacked and at least one DualShock-style controller; no readable model/version, no storage size, and no evidence of pre-installed games or specific titles.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: Witness notes dust/smudges and light scuffs, but does not show seals/opening status or internal condition.
No power-on test, temperature/fan noise observation, or gameplay/benchmark clip is shown.
No HDMI/power/USB/Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth functionality test is shown.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: Witness sees DualShock-style controllers but cannot confirm they are original, and no receipt is shown.

risks.risk: Console model/version is unknown (PS4 vs PS4 Pro vs other), which changes value and performance.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console model label (CUH-xxxx) on the back/bottom of each unit, or a boot screen showing the exact model.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic/unknown PS4-era console condition with lowest expected value.

risks.risk: Working status is unknown (may not power on, may have HDMI/USB faults, disc drive issues, or unstable performance).
risks.proof: Short video clip: power on both consoles, show HDMI output on TV, navigate menus, and (if disc drive exists) insert a disc and show it reading.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/possibly faulty electronics.

risks.risk: Disc drive functionality is unknown (one unit shows a disc drive slot area, but reading is not confirmed).
risks.proof: Clip showing a disc being inserted and the console reading/loading the game successfully.
risks.if_unproven: Price as disc-drive unconfirmed (worst case: disc drive not working).

risks.risk: Controller condition is unknown (stick drift, button issues, charging/battery health).
risks.proof: Video clip showing controller connected, stick movement calibration test (or in-game camera movement), and charging port/charging indicator.
risks.if_unproven: Price as controller condition unknown (worst case: needs repair/replacement).

risks.risk: Game claim may be inaccurate (pre-installed titles and count not verifiable from photos).
risks.proof: Photo/video of the console game library screen showing the installed games list and storage usage.
risks.if_unproven: Price without assuming the claimed game library value.

risks.risk: Cosmetic wear may indicate heavier use (dust/smudges/scuffs; possible deeper scratches or missing parts not shown).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of ports, vents, disc slot area, and all edges; include a shot of the underside/serial area.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst visible cosmetic condition.

risks.risk: Account/security status unknown (linked accounts, bans, or reset status can affect usability).
risks.proof: Video clip showing the Settings > Account Management screen and confirmation of sign-out/reset status (without exposing passwords).
risks.if_unproven: Price as account status unknown (worst case: requires reset/extra steps).

proof_requests: Clear model label photo for each console (CUH-xxxx) and storage size if shown.
Video: power on both consoles, show HDMI output working, and navigate the home menu.
Video: test disc drive by inserting a disc and showing it loading (for the unit with the disc slot area).
Video: controller test for stick drift/button responsiveness and show charging/charging port working.
Photo/video of the installed games library screen showing the actual list and count.
Close-up photos of ports (HDMI/USB/power), vents, and disc slot area; underside/serial area.
Photo/video of account status/reset readiness (Settings > Account Management) without sharing passwords.
response.reason: The witness confirms PlayStation consoles and controllers, but the exact model, working status, disc-drive function, controller health, and the claimed installed games are not verifiable from the report. Without these, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set safely.
